title: anatherum virginicum subvar. tenuispatheum
intro: Anatherum virginicum subvar. tenuispatheum, commonly known as American feather grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, alleviating respiratory issues, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of American feather grass include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to relieve symptoms of colds, coughs, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
